sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ii.product_id WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 1
),
monthly_diff AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS yyyy_mm,
    gross_revenue,
    gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS increase
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT yyyy_mm, ROUND(increase::numeric, 2) AS increase
FROM monthly_diff
WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT dc.name AS distribution_center, ROUND((SUM(oi.sale_price - ii.cost))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.distribution_centers dc ON dc.id = ii.product_distribution_center_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY dc.name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_order_counts AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
    FROM jan_users u
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
        AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2))::double precision 
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::double precision AS share
FROM user_order_counts

SELECT u.traffic_source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY gross_revenue_per_user DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600) AS median_hours FROM public.order_items WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND traffic_source = 'Facebook'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_time::date - first_order_time::date)) AS median_days
FROM first_two

WITH user_conversion AS (
  SELECT
    u.id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi
      WHERE oi.user_id = u.id
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
        AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    ) AS converted
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS total_users,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted) AS converting_users,
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted)::double precision / COUNT(*))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_conversion
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH user_orders AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN user_orders uo ON uo.user_id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
    FROM orders
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 3 THEN order_time END) AS third_order_time
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE order_rank IN (2, 3)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (third_order_time - second_order_time)) / 86400))::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM second_third

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
) sub

WITH organic_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
order_times AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN organic_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM order_times
),
first_second AS (
  SELECT
    r1.user_id,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (r2.order_time - r1.order_time)) AS days_between
  FROM ranked_orders r1
  JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH order_level AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        user_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_time,
        SUM(sale_price) AS order_value
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
first_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MIN(order_time) AS first_order_time
    FROM order_level
    GROUP BY user_id
),
flagged_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.user_id,
        ol.order_value,
        CASE WHEN ol.order_time = fo.first_order_time THEN 'first' ELSE 'repeat' END AS order_type
    FROM order_level ol
    JOIN first_orders fo ON fo.user_id = ol.user_id
),
medians AS (
    SELECT 
        order_type,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_value
    FROM flagged_orders
    GROUP BY order_type
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_type = 'first' THEN median_value END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_type = 'repeat' THEN median_value END) AS difference
FROM medians

WITH non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM non_cancelled_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MIN(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_time,
           MIN(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) AS second_time
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM (second_time - first_time)))::numeric, 0) AS p95_days
FROM first_two

WITH search_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
user_first_two AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
  FROM ranked_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_time::date - first_order_time::date)) AS median_days
FROM user_first_two
